title: Ameresco Secures $125 Million Financing from Nuveen to Support European Growth
body_markdown:
The five-year facility, which matures in November 2031, is intended to provide dedicated capital to support energy infrastructure projects and working capital requirements across Ameresco’s operations in the United Kingdom and Europe. The financing is structured with limited recourse to Ameresco, Inc. and does not affect the Company’s senior secured corporate leverage ratios, supporting a more self-sustaining European capital structure. The facility will also provide flexibility to increase available capital as project activity and working capital requirements grow.


“We are pleased to be working with Nuveen again as a trusted financing partner,” said Josh Baribeau, Senior Vice President and Chief Investment Officer at Ameresco. “This facility gives our European business dedicated, long-term capital to support project execution and working-capital needs as we expand across the region. The scalable structure gives us the flexibility to add additional capacity as our European operations grow.”


“This facility gives us the capital to support the planned growth of our European business which has grown from $62 million in revenue in 2022 to $529 million in 2025, now representing approximately 25% of Ameresco’s revenues,” said George Sakellaris, Chairman and CEO of Ameresco. “Driving this growth has been the growing demand for renewable energy given increasing electricity demand and costs throughout Europe. We also see a significant opportunity for us to bring our battery energy storage (BESS) expertise to the European market, which is just beginning to utilize this technology. Our technology expertise and agnostic approach positions Ameresco to build out the energy infrastructure that European customers need.”


“We look forward to continuing our partnership with Ameresco and providing long-term capital solutions to support its growing European business,” said Don Dimitrievich, Portfolio Manager of Nuveen’s Energy Infrastructure Credit business. “Supporting energy infrastructure companies like Ameresco that advance the low-carbon transition and strengthen energy security is central to our strategy.”


**About Ameresco, Inc.**


Ameresco, Inc. (NYSE: AMRC) is a leading energy infrastructure company delivering integrated solutions to create reliable power and modernize infrastructure. The company’s Power Infrastructure business integrates energy resources across behind-the-meter and utility-scale systems. Its Buildings & Public Infrastructure business modernizes the built environment with smart, connected solutions that optimize performance and enhance resilience. Ameresco is a trusted full lifecycle partner, delivering over $15 billion in solutions and contracting over 5 GW of energy resources since its founding in 2000. Headquartered in Massachusetts, Ameresco serves public and private sector customers across North America and Europe. Learn more at[www.ameresco.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ameresco.com&esheet=54640500&newsitemid=20261112278475&lan=en-US&anchor=www.ameresco.com&index=2&md5=088cdb151ac64e9c16d86ce85adb4bd8) .
